title.narrative: Protecting the rights of the most vulnerable during the Covid-19 crisis

description.narrative: The overall objective of this action is to contribute to enhanced human rights protection for the most vulnerable in the wake of the Covid-19 outbreak in Pakistan. The projects specific objective is to redress the existing inequalities exacerbated by the Covid-19 pandemic, particularly discrimination based on gender, gender identity, faith, occupation, or status.
